statement: Trade reporting says CPO switch order books are full through 2027 and supplies tight into 2028, with optical engine yield and advanced packaging capacity cited as key expansion bottlenecks.
why: Order books full more than a year out mean the fabric side is sold out, so packaging and optical yield now gate how fast new clusters can be wired.

impact.mechanism: Optical engine yield and advanced packaging capacity limit CPO switch output while order books are already full, constraining how quickly cluster fabric can scale alongside accelerators.

evidence.excerpt: other trade press says order books are full through 2027 and supplies tight into 2028, with the CPO switch market volume ramp expected in 2027-2028

confidence.basis: Unnamed 'other trade press' relayed inside one secondary article; the TrendForce release cited alongside it predates the window and was not fetched here.
